group_note: group = the section the person renders in (founder / board / team), taken from the approved copy PDF §3. Designations, quotes and bios for the eight people the PDF names come from that PDF; everyone else keeps the designation published on deonenergy.in/about-us and has no bio.

people.name: Dharmesh Makadiya
people.bio: Dharmesh Makadiya is the founder of Deon Energy Limited and leads the company as Chairman and Managing Director. With years of experience across renewable energy and business development, he has shaped the company’s technical standards, its growth in the Gujarat market, and its long-term direction in the Indian solar sector.
people.quote: Our focus is on building with purpose, creating lasting value, and moving the renewable energy sector forward through responsible leadership.

people.name: Chirag Kalariya
people.bio: As Whole-Time Director, Chirag Kalariya contributes to the strategic direction and continued development of Deon Energy. His focus is on responsible decision-making, structured business growth, and building long-term value for the organisation and its stakeholders.
people.quote: Strong businesses are built through clear thinking, responsible decisions, and a commitment to creating lasting value.
